GOAL: orient before proposing one behaviour+hyperbolic SID coupling idea.
READ: workspace agent directory listing.
OBSERVED: (pending) will inspect repo context for existing mechanisms to avoid duplicating.
EVIDENCE: local paths.
REASONING: need to know what RQ-VAE/Stage3 baseline already does.
OPEN: which coupling slot to occupy (distinct from other 4 agents).

FINAL ANSWER RECORD (summary of the deliverable).
IDEA: LORENTZ_CONE_RQ. TITLE: behaviour-weighted Lorentz future-cone ordering inside geodesic residual quantisation.
SLOT: fourth design slot, not weighted assignment, not mere hyperbolic latent, not a curved residual loss alone: a transition-mass-weighted causal-cone ORDER on the hierarchical codebook, applied to the same centroids used by a log/exp residual quantiser.
BEHAVIOUR: popularity-adjusted directed item transition mass from the Stage-2 training split only (pairs within next 3 positions of the same session, PMI clipped to [-4,4], aggregated to codebook level, row-normalised, top-8 kept).
GEOMETRY: Lorentz model, trainable curvature kappa=-c^2, c=exp(rho), rho init 0, clamped to [-1.5,1.5]; d_L=(1/c)arcosh(-c^2<x,y>_L); geodesic log/exp at the parent centroid; future-cone order.
COUPLING: L_cone = sum_{l,a,b} M_l[a,b] * relu(<e_{l+1,b}-e_{l,a}, e_{l+1,b}-e_{l,a}>_L + m); residual x_l = exp_{e_{l,a}}(t_{l,k}) with k = argmin ||log_{e_{l,a}}(x_{l-1}) - t_{l,k}||^2. Behaviour sets the weights, geometry sets the order and the residual step, and the output feeds the emitted SID prefix, so either ablation changes the SIDs.
ABLATIONS: behaviour off = M set to 1 on the same support; geometry off = Euclidean surrogate (L2 distance, identity maps, radial-order hinge relu(||e_{l+1,b}||-||e_{l,a}||+m)); both on = the coupled run. One run only, no ablation arm trained.
COST at frozen scale (24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs = 72000 steps): one pre-pass over training transitions to build M (<60 s); per step ~3 levels x 2048 sampled transition pairs = ~6k hinge evaluations plus a 256x256 gather, +3-6% step time; 0.8M floats of M.
OBSERVABLES: cone-violation rate on training transition pairs, level-2 prefix predictability given level-1 code, SID churn between epoch 500 and 3000, Stage3 test Recall@10 (target > 0.065).
SAFEGUARDS: arcosh clamp at 1+1e-6, hyperboloid renormalisation, ||u||_L clamp, M floor 1e-6, grad clip 1.0, curvature clamp kappa<=-0.05, c=exp(rho) so curvature stays negative.
LEAKAGE: M computed once from the training split before Stage 2 and frozen; validation/test never read.
STATUS: final answer printed in the response; no run executed.
